Referring Clinician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Follow-up karyotype analysis post rapid PCR testing. Rule out Down syndrome.

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. Analysis was performed at 400-450 band resolution.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

No trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities detected.

Analysis of 15 metaphase cells showed a normal female chromosome complement. The analysis quality was sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements only. Subtle structural abnormalities below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics cannot be excluded.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. This result excludes Down syndrome (trisomy 21) and other common chromosomal aneuploidies. This finding is concordant with the previous rapid PCR result.

LIMITATIONS
G-banded karyotype analysis cannot detect:
- Microdeletions/microduplications <5-10 Mb
- Low-level mosaicism (<20%)
- Balanced rearrangements not visible at this resolution
- Single gene mutations

Authorized by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Date: [redacted date]
